scope: One frozen MoNuSeg nested-CV fold only; adapted released FoB source, public 37-case MoNuSeg train images, official ResNet-101 initialization, and local SAM ViT-H decoding.

inner_validation_selection.selection_rule: largest mean Dice; ties use smaller training step

outer_test.query_ground_truth_policy: Query masks were loaded only after FoB prompts and SAM-H predictions, solely to calculate Dice.

interpretation: The direct pathology adaptation failed on this fold. This is a diagnostic negative-transfer result, not a fair head-to-head comparison with the primary five-fold DINOv2-L plus SAM ViT-B protocol and not evidence of superiority or inferiority of either published method.
